title: senecio palmatus var. cannabifolius
intro: Senecio palmatus var. cannabifolius, commonly known as the Fingered Ragwort or Cannabifolius Ragwort, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Senecio palmatus var. cannabifolius include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although further research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties.
